communications.subject: The Kansas Open Records Act Request: Correctional Healthcare Contracting Documents (2001-2025)
communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the The Kansas Open Records Act, I hereby request the following records:

All available contracting and procurement documents and communications (ex. retained email correspondence between provider and state entity), including requests for proposals (RFPs) and/or requests for quotes (RFQs); all bids and proposals; all executed contracts with amendments, extensions, and supportive materials (active and expired); and any related agreements between Kansas Department of Corrections and/or Kansas State Government and private healthcare contracting corporations that were active or published between January 1, 2001 and December 31, 2025. This includes any contracts that were active before 2001 and were active during the period of interest.    

To assist in your search, we believe that this request should include, but not be limited to, CONTRACT #0000000000000000000059921. 

If healthcare operations for incarcerated individuals in Kansas State Prisons were contracted to entities other than private healthcare contracting corporations (ex. Universities or hospital systems), we would request the same available documents during active or published between January 1, 2001 and December 31, 2025.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 3 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Elizabeth Evans-Ralston

title: Communication Between UNR and Turning Point USA

communications.subject: Nevada Public Records Act Request: Communication Between UNR and Turning Point USA
communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Nevada Public Records Act, I hereby request the following records:

any documentation of communication between the University of Nevada, Reno, and Charlie Kirk or any representative of Turning Point USA in October 2019. 
Please include texts, emails, letters, or the like that may pertain to this request. 

This request is being made by a journalistic researcher. It is being made for research purposes, not commercial ones. Please assess fees in accordance with provisions for media requesters. In the event that this agency decides to charge this requester fees not to exceed the actual cost of reproducing the records, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 5 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Judah Trease
